name: Atlas Independent Method Comparison
rules: Both lanes receive the same immutable source packet and stage order.
A lane may return UNRESOLVED but may not omit a required field.
Later stages may consume only the source packet and earlier outputs from the same lane.
Neither lane sees the other lane before comparison.
Agreement is not truth, proof, evidence grade, or admission.
Raw responses, backend identity, prompts, hashes, and refusals are preserved.

stages.title: Claim extraction
stages.instruction: Extract at most 30 material, separable claims. Ignore navigation and page furniture. Preserve exact source quotations. Do not combine evidence with the claim.

stages.title: Claim classification
stages.instruction: Classify every extracted claim by epistemic mode and native domain. Mode must be one of AXIOM, PRE_ASSUMPTION, EMPIRICAL_EVENT, HISTORICAL_RECORD, MATHEMATICAL_PROOF, FORMAL_DERIVATION, CLASSIFICATION, INTERPRETATION, SYMBOLIC_TRUTH, MORAL_CLAIM, THEOLOGICAL_CLAIM, EXPERIENTIAL_REPORT, PREDICTION, UNKNOWN. UNKNOWN is allowed.

stages.title: Dependency and load-bearing analysis
stages.instruction: Identify directed dependencies and nominate load-bearing claims. Proposals are not admitted graph edges.

stages.title: Falsification and kill conditions
stages.instruction: State a concrete defeat or revision condition for each material claim. Do not pretend every theological claim is laboratory-falsifiable.

stages.title: Evidence and warrant mapping
stages.instruction: Separate source support from independent evidence requirements. Do not count restatement as corroboration.

stages.title: Contradiction and tension scan
stages.instruction: Identify contradictions or tensions with exact claim references. Absence of a detected contradiction is not proof of coherence.

stages.title: Nabla and DG7 dynamics
stages.instruction: Produce the exact Nabla ten-dimension semantic proposal as integer scores 0..3 for G,M,E,S,T,K,R,Q,F,C. Produce DG7 statuses PRESENT, PARTIAL, ABSENT, or UNRESOLVED for coherence,degradation,measure,threshold,asymmetry,restoration,counterexample. This is a proposal. Lexical absence never adjudicates a veto, so veto_status must be NOT_ADJUDICATED.

stages.title: Natural process mirror gate
stages.instruction: For every load-bearing process, sequence, derivation, restoration pattern, bridge, or claimed cross-domain structure, ask whether there is an endogenous natural-world process in physics, biology, chemistry, cosmology, information theory, or another empirical domain that mirrors it. A mirror candidate must decompose both sides into the same ordered parts, preserve directionality, preserve function, name constraints and failure modes, and disclose losses or introduced structure. If a source process has 12 parts, the proposed natural mirror must account for those 12 parts in the same order unless it is explicitly marked partial or failed. Do not promote analogy to isomorphism. If no candidate exists, return unresolved questions and mirror_gate_status NEEDS_NATURAL_ANCHOR.

stages.title: Page-level synthesis
stages.instruction: Aggregate the lane's prior outputs into a coherent account with unresolved items and explicit limits. Do not promote Candidate material.
